articles.summary: HOUSTON, June 1, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Summit Midstream Corporation (NYSE: SMC) ("Summit," "SMC" or the "Company") today announced that its Board of Directors has authorized the Company's inaugural stock repurchase program to repurchase up to $35 million of the Company's outstanding common stock.
articles.title: Summit Midstream Corporation Announces Inaugural $35 Million Stock Repurchase Program

articles.title: Summit Midstream Secures Additional Double E Commitments and Extends Open Season Amid Strong Shipper Demand
